title: Lesson
description: A lesson of a module: a sequence that its author made — explanations, worked examples and tasks, in order — and the skills of the module that it teaches. The skill graph orders the lessons.

id.description: The lesson's local ID: the name of its file, without .yaml.

title.description: What the lesson is called, in the module's explanation language. The learner sees it before every task of the lesson, and the leak check searches it for their keys.

skills.description: The skills of the module, by local ID, that the lesson teaches. Every task of the lesson trains one of them as a primary skill.

age_categories.description: The age categories that the lesson suits, when they are fewer than the module's: the platform gives the lesson only to a learner whom the lesson and each of its tasks suit.

segments.description: The segments of the lesson, in the author's order: explanations, worked examples and tasks. No two are the same.

explanation.description: An explanation: paragraphs, pictures and numbered lists that the learner reads, in order, in the module's explanation language.

worked_example.description: A worked example: an example solved before the learner's eyes, on a handwriting sheet.

task.description: A task of the module, by its local ID. The next segment begins when the task ends.

segment.description: A segment of a lesson: an explanation, a worked example or a task, by its one field.

picture.description: A picture, by its path from media/: a lesson has no template, so its path holds no placeholder.

alt.description: What the picture shows, in words: a screen reader reads it, and it stands in the picture's place until the picture comes. Empty for a picture that only decorates.

width.description: The width the picture is shown at, in CSS px; narrower when the text it stands in is.

height.description: The height the picture is shown at, in CSS px, in proportion to its width.

numbered_list.description: A numbered list: its texts in order, such as the steps of a method, each a short text that does not begin with a number of its own, as 1. or 1) does. The learner's app draws the numbers, so the leak check reads none of them; it searches the texts as it searches the paragraphs.

explanation_part.description: A part of an explanation: a numbered list, or a paragraph or a picture with what it shows and its size, as a part of a task's statement is; a lesson's picture path holds no placeholder.

picture.description: A picture, by its path from media/: a lesson has no template, so its path holds no placeholder.

statement.description: What the example asks: paragraphs and pictures in order, as a task's statement.

canvas.description: What the author's demo is shown on: a handwriting sheet and its grid, or a workbook, the example's lines with their boxes. The learner does not write on it.

lines.description: On a workbook: the example's lines, each with its boxes and what they hold, laid out on the page as a task's lines are.

demo.description: The author's demo: the parts of how the example is solved, in order, which the learner opens one at a time and may hide.

worked_example.description: A worked example of a lesson: no task, with no answer slots and no key. On a handwriting sheet the demo shows pictures on the sheet; on a workbook it fills the boxes of the example's lines.

demo.description: On a workbook, no picture stands on the sheet.
On a handwriting sheet, no box is filled.

line.description: The pieces of the line, in order, a box among them at least.

example_line.description: A line of a worked example on a workbook.

text.description: A piece of text of the line.

value.description: Of a box: what the demo writes in it when a part fills it.

example_line_part.description: A piece of a line of a worked example: a piece of text, or a box with what the demo writes in it.

text.description: A paragraph of the demo, as plain text.

picture.description: A picture of the demo, by its path from media/.

alt.description: What the picture shows, in words: a screen reader reads it, and it stands in the picture's place until the picture comes. Empty for a picture that only decorates.

width.description: The width that a picture beside the sheet is shown at, in CSS px.

height.description: The height that a picture beside the sheet is shown at, in CSS px, in proportion to its width.

area.description: The area of the sheet that a picture on the sheet is shown in, at its size, on the canvas layer of the author's demo.

fill.description: Of a worked example on a workbook: the box that this part of the demo fills with its value.

demo_part.description: A part of the author's demo: a paragraph; a picture beside the sheet, with what it shows and its size; a picture on the sheet, with what it shows and its area; or, on a workbook, a box filled.

line.description: The line, by its place among the example's lines, from 1.

box.description: The box, by its place among the boxes of the line, from 1.

demo_fill.description: A box of a worked example's lines, by its line and its place in it.
